snippet.title: M.E.A.T. II Absolute Zero | OFFICIAL TRAILER | EARLY ACCESS (2026)
snippet.description:
M.E.A.T. II: Absolute Zero enters Early Access on PC!

Join the fight, check out new mechanics, weapons, locations, and enemies - and most importantly, help Trippin Bears studio polish the game before its official release.

Your feedback has a real impact on the development of the project.
Play now and help us build the M.E.A.T. community 🔥

◾️ WWW 📲 https://meatrpg.com/
◾️ STEAM 📲 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2176710/MEAT_II_Absolute_Zero/
◾️ FACEBOOK 📲 /meatrpg
◾️ INSTAGRAM 📲 /meat_rpg
◾️ MARKETING & COOPERATION: karolina@meatrpg.com
